text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Dark olive green long sleeve button shirt worn open at upper chest, ivory relaxed jeans, white sneakers.. Add ONLY these accessories: A dark forest green baseball cap with curved peak and a tiny pale front monogram.; Black narrow rectangular sunglasses with dark lenses, both temples visible in three-quarter product view.; A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product photo to remove unwanted additions. Remove the black belt. Preserve olive shirt, white jeans, white sneakers, green cap, sunglasses and silver necklace. Preserve all other cuts, colors, proportions and fabric detail. Empty hollow clothes, no skin or mannequin, white seamless background, full outfit uncropped. Do not add anything.
